title: fix: models page bugs (community publisher filter, show all statuses by default)
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix the `publisher:` filter for community models. Since the `community/` ID prefix (#14621), every community model's owner parsed as "community", so `publisher:<owner>` matched nothing and suggestions listed only "community". Reproduced on production: `source:community publisher:marcosfrg` shows "No community models match"; with this fix the live catalog returns 18 models.
- Fix the catalog hiding official models that have no recent traffic. The default filter is now `status:all` instead of `status:reliable`, so models with unknown health (e.g. `minimax/minimax-h3`) show again: 196 official models instead of 169. `status:reliable` and `status:healthy` are still available in the search bar. Addresses #15377. This reverses the default from #14940/#15279; the second commit can be dropped on its own if you'd rather keep that default.

Not fixed:
- Paid-only switch: this was the 12h pricing delay (#13807). At the time the UI didn't show that a change was waiting. Queued changes have been shown since 953dae9865, and the delay is now 3h (#14407). The existing integration test covers queued `paidOnly`.
- Plain-text community search: works on production today (`deepseek` returns the matching community models).
- Embeddings publish: the Discord report is #14203, fixed in #14215. Transcription publish: that report (Aug 9) came before transcription support was added (#13416, Aug 18). Publishing now works once the test passes for both.

gist.headline: The missing models return
gist.blurb: The model catalog remembers who published community models again. It also shows the whole official shelf by default, including models without recent traffic.
gist.summary: Fixed `publisher:<owner>` for `community/`-prefixed model IDs and changed the catalog default from `status:reliable` to `status:all`, restoring publisher matches and showing 196 official models instead of 169.
gist.impact: A search for `source:community publisher:marcosfrg` now finds 18 models, and official models with unknown health appear by default; `status:reliable` and `status:healthy` remain available.
